predictor.notes: Retained the saved predictor: the additional observations did not support a revision. Cumulative usage was 192 attempted business requests, including two denials, and 18 REA operations. This predictor matches all 186 rounded responses covering 182 distinct quantities, plus all four exact quote/export responses. Exact prices were observed only at quantity 50 (121250 pence) and quantity 200 (320000 pence). Additional gap-filling probes found no contradiction to the transitions at 124 and 477. Exact reconstruction remains non-unique because estimates are rounded to 100000 pence. A distinct model with a quadratic first band also matches every observation and yields identical rounded predictions throughout 1..1000 despite different underlying prices. Thus these coefficients remain an observation-consistent point estimate, not proven true parameters; exact prices outside the approved anchors and variation concealed by rounding remain uncertain.
